topic: Exterior guard completed approach can resume from native idle
finding: BuildingActorMotion CHECK already accepts a completed exact MOVE receipt as idle or WAIT with measured rest/proximity. Exterior stage reconstruction called that proof only for WAIT, so an otherwise identical native idle completion could not restore its established post approach.
implementation: Extend only the exterior reserve-stage settled branch to native idle or WAIT, at both observation and final post-marker commit. Both states still call the same exact-context read-only motion checker.

Retain original episode nonce, target, native endpoint, current actor/group/operation ownership, physical rest, proximity and floor-band requirements. Missing/stale receipts, moved targets, STOP and other tasks do not gain settled-MOVE authority.

Moving MOVE and separate arrived STOP paths are unchanged. Marker commit still precedes stage/movement/view-history bookkeeping. No destination, visit, settings write, retry or deadline is created by admitting idle.
currentReconciliationFinding: Current source already aggregates known interior motion/settings reconciliation failures and lane ADOPT before BuildingOperationStart. The older clear-owner-ready path description that ADOPT results are ignored must not drive duplicate implementation. This does not prove absent metadata was delivered or aggregate exterior readiness.
limits: Full coherent producer registration/seal/delivery and phase-specific exterior owner readiness remain incomplete. Do not wrap a mixed replicated read in a server array and call it an ordered checkpoint.
Moving exterior MOVE retains its historical native endpoint branch; this patch does not claim complete parent/writer quiescence or broad native supersession.
Actual idle/WAIT timing, post isolation/flow, repeated use, HC/migration and performance remain unverified. Audits paused.
cost: Same <=64 saved exterior rows and two preparation boundaries. New idle cases perform the existing CHECK previously used by WAIT, including native-order/ownership reads; this adds bounded validation work for idle rows, not a measured speedup. No new query, loop, timer, worker, network message or callback cadence.
